bundle.shortDescription: A virtual rat in an operant chamber
bundle.longDescription: Rattus is an open-source simulation of a rat in an operant chamber (Skinner box) for teaching the psychology of learning: magazine training, shaping, extinction, spontaneous recovery, schedules of reinforcement and classical conditioning of fear.
